review.recipe: Small chilled stemmed wine glass, transparent deep amber tea-cognac Crusta, fine outside sugar crust and corrected long half-lemon peel collar, no ice.
review.personality: Pressed dinner napkin and fork, neatly draped repaired jacket convey kept standards. Portrait window retains fork head, napkin and substantial jacket; no military costume.
review.world: Old timber bar and worn walnut, sole right practical lamp after removal of unintended fireplace flames, neutral near-black shadows, blank cream tied tag.
